subject: Review of manuscript on an alternative parameterization of dynamic occupancy models

messages.author: 247b990d236a7af6
messages.subject: Review of manuscript on an alternative parameterization of dynamic occupancy models
parts:
I have a relatively short (9 pages, double-spaced) draft manuscript on an alternative parameterization of dynamic occupancy models (based on something my major professor wrote over 60 years ago) which goes after modeling occupancy directly (rather than first estimating colonization and extinction and then occupancy).

I'm looking for someone to take a look at it to see if I'm way off base or not.  If you're interested in reviewing it, please e-mail me directly.

Thanks,

Jim
